issues.description: Conditional registration is placed outside the class body, breaking the Math_unary registration on Python <3.11.
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block in mathdecl.py is dedented to module scope, which means a blank line now separates the class from its decorator. More seriously, on 3.11+ the rebinding `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` re-registers the same ConcreteTemplate as a second global, but the author cannot state the postcondition of `infer_global` when applied twice. Reason about it before writing it.

issues.description: `sys` is referenced in mathimpl.py files without being imported.
issues.detail: Both `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` introduce `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` but the diff shows no `import sys`. If the module did not already import sys, this is a NameError at import time. The author tested a path; they did not reason about the precondition `sys is bound`. TESTED-NOT-PROVED.

issues.description: Version gate uses two inconsistent idioms across three files for the same predicate.
issues.detail: mathdecl.py and mathimpl.py use `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)`; the test uses `PYVERSION >= (3, 11)` from `numba.core.utils`. The invariant `"exp2 is registered iff exp2 is tested"` should rest on one predicate, not two. Pick `PYVERSION` (the project's existing abstraction) everywhere, or justify the divergence.

issues.description: Test inputs include negative integers for unsigned types, silently relying on wraparound.
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` is fed through `uint16/uint32/uint64`. The precondition of `math.exp2` on Python is `x is real`; the precondition of the test is unstated. Either the test relies on C-style wraparound (then state it) or the negatives are noise that should be removed for unsigned types. Copy-pasted from `test_exp` does not constitute reasoning.

issues.description: Release note file is missing a terminating newline and the underline length is fragile.
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file` and the RST underline must match the title length exactly. A minor hygiene matter, but the discipline of treating documents as artifacts subject to specification applies here too.

issues.description: No correctness reasoning offered for `llvm.exp2` on integer inputs.
issues.detail: The implementation reuses `unary_math_intr`, which presumably casts ints to float before invoking the LLVM intrinsic. The author does not state this precondition, nor confirm that `llvm.exp2` is defined over the chosen float domain on all supported targets. The PR shows a mechanism; it does not show reasoning. REASONED would require one paragraph.

review.summary: A small, well-intentioned patch that mimics the pattern of `math.exp` without reasoning about the modifications it makes to that pattern. Two likely import-time defects (missing `import sys` in two files; a dedented conditional that rebinds `Math_unary` outside the class body) suggest the author tested the Python-3.11 path and did not reason about the Python-3.10 path. Version-gating idioms diverge across files, and the test reuses negative integer inputs for unsigned types without stating why. Verdict: TESTED-NOT-PROVED; resubmit after stating precondition, postcondition, and the invariant that the patch must hold across supported Python versions.
